fragments.text: When I asked AI to compose a hi-coup, Island breeze blowing, Hawaii should be free to roam, far from mainland chains. Would this have been my creation, or an act of God, even a libation, poured from the lips of man to the freedom poetry gods? But this was AI. Just AI. Yet AI cleaned up at the best new artist stand, taking its cue from creative man, stealing from our minds now tied up in knots, or collective efforts given over to the latest chatbot, to hurl, spit, regurgitate, and expropriate, write back in or collective face, or individualism as bait, no thought given, no travail, no mirth hidden, no current debate, no draft upon draft of ideas to weigh,

fragments.text: This is AI's inherent wrong. For with AI as our black slate, we're not able to get out of the gate. We're not yet free from mainland chains. We're nowhere than inside the wheel for out of the mouth of box rises a new native tongue or ancestral language undone. The ages of poetry now defunct lumped into a universal brand, everything we need at a glance. Intelligent life now artificially imbibed. They drive dangerously over the train tracks of time, cause and effect. For what is poetry, but a reflection of the age, golden glue, silver hue, iron hand, or sassy brass? For what are their lived experiences that enable them to participate in or vernacular?
fragments.summary: For with AI as our black slate, we're not able to get out of the gate.

fragments.text: And what will be our lived experiences? If we stop looking around or within, if we stop hearing human sounds, for it's either that we drive them or they drive us. If we drive them, they must only augment us. If they drive us, we will lose ourselves on just one touch. We will turn up the sound at their monotone drone. For we have brought them here to solve the world's unknown, be neither God nor man. We will have become a bystander on the periphery of our own minds or brains trained to react only to the voice of AI. Their vestigial remains intact, soulless creatures, wings that feebly flap at freedoms for gotten song. For we will have forgotten the cry of the goal.
fragments.summary: If we stop looking around or within, if we stop hearing human sounds, for it's either that we drive them or they drive us.

fragments.text: We will have forgotten the sound of our own voices, like curse they've no longer used. We will atrophy from attrition. AI cannot be more than the sum of us. We must use it for what it was intended. But how do we know what that is? The AI face off is at best, left to what can be known and quantifiable, discernible by theorem. The many uses of a toothpick, the most efficient way to build a house, the rate at which we need to slow down global warming, so we don't deliequise, but do not mess with humanness. Machines cannot replicate or creative endeavors, a concept elusive at best. Creativity is not area darkness. It is not machine learning or brain power.
